visual_synopsis: An elderly couple, both played by men in old-age makeup and the wife in a white wig and glasses, sit side by side on a sofa under a wall carpet, bickering while a music video plays on their CRT television. The wife then goes out to the hallway wardrobe and comes back down the corridor grinning and holding up a navy striped sweater, intercut with a scruffy young man in an orange plaid shirt reacting with wide-eyed shouting in the building stairwell before he trudges back up the stairs.
